summary: Frontend-only validation of the CRM Company Assets tab 'Equipment source of truth' reconciliation panel for AlphaCo (iso-cA). All 6 acceptance criteria pass end-to-end: panel renders with register count, single duplicate row (qa-ast-dup) is detected via serial match, CRM-only Vending Machine note is shown, Link button POSTs to /api/crm/v2/assets/qa-ast-dup/link-equipment (200), sonner success toast appears ('Linked to the register — no more duplicate'), panel refreshes so the duplicate row disappears and the header now shows '1 linked'; existing CRM asset rows still render below the panel; no console errors.
test_flow_executed: Login owner@isodemo.com / IsoDemo123! at /login → redirected to /service-desk
Verified panel text: 'Equipment source of truth · Operations register: 4'
Verified asset-reconcile-duplicates section with asset-dup-qa-ast-dup: 'Treadmill (dup) (S/N sn-abc-123 · matched by serial)'
Verified asset-reconcile-crmonly text: '1 CRM-only asset(s) not in the register (manually added).'
Sonner toast displayed: 'Linked to the register — no more duplicate'
Panel now shows '· 1 linked' badge; asset-reconcile-duplicates section is gone; crm-only still visible
CRM asset rows ('Treadmill (dup)' + 'Vending Machine') still render beneath the panel
critical_code_review_comments: CRMCompanies.js is 2032 lines — recommend splitting CompanyDetail, sub-tab components (AssetReconcilePanel, ServiceActivityTab, PortalEquipmentTab, SitesAndEquipmentTab, CompanyFileTab) into separate files for maintainability (already flagged by prior iterations; not blocking).

AssetReconcilePanel silently swallows load errors (setData(null) → returns null with no visible state). Consider a small error indicator so ops know when reconciliation could not be computed. Not a bug for this slice.
seed_data_creation: Used pre-seeded data (iso-cA / qa-eq-1 / qa-ast-dup / qa-ast-only). No new seed required.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The Link action mutates state (qa-ast-dup is now linked). If re-testing, backend must reset qa-ast-dup to UNLINKED (source != 'operations_equipment', equipment_id null) before running the Link click again. Backend endpoints: GET /api/crm/v2/companies/{id}/asset-reconciliation and POST /api/crm/v2/assets/{asset_id}/link-equipment (both verified 200).
rca of the issue: N/A — no issues found; feature works as specified.
